scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
This place is too dangerous for you to explore alone.
scripts.translation: 这里太危险了，你不能独自探索。

scripts.text: Please form a party and come with your comrades.
scripts.translation: 请组队后和同伴一起来。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
Only party leaders can control access to the Temple of the Demon God.
scripts.translation: 只有队长可以申请进入魔神殿。

scripts.text: It's to ensure the safety of the entire Expedition. Please let your leader talk to me instead.
scripts.translation: 这是为了确保整个远征队的安全。请让队长来和我谈。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
I'm sorry, but you can't enter this place without approval from the Commander.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，没有指挥官的批准，你不能进入这里。

scripts.text: You must be on the quest to subjugate the Demon God to enter this place.
scripts.translation: 必须接取讨伐魔神的任务才能进入这里。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
Please go to Commander Hiva Agip and receive the Demon God Subjugation quest.
scripts.translation: 请去找指挥官希瓦·阿吉普，接取讨伐魔神的任务。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
I've been waiting for you, hero-in-waiting.
scripts.translation: 我等你很久了，未来的英雄。

scripts.text: Let me guide you to the depth of the temple where Morroc lies in wait.
scripts.translation: 让我带你前往魔王梦罗克潜伏的神殿深处。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
This tree is the spitting image of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 这棵树简直和世界树一模一样。

scripts.text: I just hope Morroc is not intent on what I fear most.
scripts.translation: 我只希望梦罗克没有打算做我最担心的事。

scripts.text: Through this tree the door is opened.
scripts.translation: 通往那里的门会经由这棵树开启。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
I can sense that
this tree is generating mana at certain intervals as if it's breathing.
scripts.translation: 这棵树正像呼吸一样，间隔一段时间便释放出魔力。

scripts.text: I'm going to catch a moment between its breaths to open up a path for you. Are you ready?
scripts.translation: 我会趁它两次释放魔力之间为你开辟通路。准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Enter now.
Do not enter.
[Nidhogg]
Okay.
I understand if you need time.
scripts.translation: 如果你还需要时间，我能理解。

scripts.text: Take your time. I can wait as long as you want me to.
scripts.translation: 慢慢来，你想让我等多久都可以。

scripts.text: Enter through the tree.
Don't be scared, even though it's not an ordinary tree.
scripts.translation: 别害怕，虽然这不是一棵普通的树。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
You have eliminated the God of Despair!?
I can only say that his ambition was too big...
scripts.translation: 只能说他的野心太大了...

scripts.text: Always talk about creating a new world and becoming a god...
scripts.translation: 总把创造新世界、成为神明挂在嘴边...

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
But seriously, he didn't create anything at all!
scripts.translation: 可说真的，他根本什么都没创造出来！

scripts.text: Abandon the body that used to be a demon, and the appearance after rebirth is just imitating the god...
scripts.translation: 舍弃原本身为魔物的躯体，重生后的外形也只是在模仿神明...

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
The result is just what a human looks like,
scripts.translation: 结果看起来不过像个人，

scripts.text: He can't escape the so-called god frame,
scripts.translation: 根本摆脱不了所谓神明的框架，

scripts.text: ...you can only say that you are eating bad luck!
[Nidhogg]
I will give you approval for the quest, and you can report to the commander.
scripts.translation: 我会为你完成任务确认，然后你就可以向指挥官报告了。

scripts.text: Thank you!

scripts.translation: 请去找指挥官希瓦·阿吉普，接取“讨伐魔神”任务。

scripts.text: You touched the tree and felt a strange flow of mana.
scripts.translation: 你触碰树木，感受到一股奇异的魔力流动。

scripts.text: Perhaps the flow of mana will guide you to the depth of the temple.
scripts.translation: 也许这股魔力流会指引你前往神殿深处。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
No entry permission has been issued under the name of your party.
scripts.translation: 你的队伍尚未获得入场许可。

scripts.text: Please let your party leader submit an entry request, and I'll open the gate to the temple.
scripts.translation: 请让队长提出入场申请，我就会为你们打开神殿大门。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
You are to comply with the rules set by the Expedition.
scripts.translation: 你必须遵守远征队制定的规则。

scripts.text: It's for everyone's safety.
scripts.translation: 这是为了所有人的安全。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
Um...how could this happen... the flow of magic power becomes unstable,
scripts.translation: 嗯...怎么会这样...魔力流动变得不稳定了，

scripts.text: It hurts my brain, this is the gap I finally made...
scripts.translation: 真让人头疼，我好不容易才打开的通道...

[Ahat]
Welcome
to the Temple of the Demon God.
It's my honor to be your host today.
scripts.translation: 今天由我接待各位，真是荣幸。

scripts.text: [Ahat]
So, you've come.
Gosh, you're so persistent.
Hah hah, are you surprised to see me here?
scripts.translation: 哈哈，看到我在这里很惊讶吗？

scripts.text: [Ahat]
Didn't you expect this at all?
Why don't I introduce myself officially?
scripts.translation: 我正式自我介绍一下吧？

scripts.text: I'm Ahat, the first servant of the Demon God.
scripts.translation: 我是魔神的第一侍从，阿哈特。

scripts.text: [Ahat]
Well, well, maybe I forfeit my life today.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，看来我今天可能要丢掉性命了。

scripts.text: Don't look at me like that. Everything is as planned.
scripts.translation: 别那样看着我。一切都在计划之中。

scripts.text: [Ahat]
My master wishes for Shnaim and I to put you to the test.
scripts.translation: 主人希望施奈姆和我考验你们。

scripts.text: To see if you deserve to be our guests.
scripts.translation: 看看你们是否有资格成为我们的客人。

scripts.text: [Ahat]
If you think you've come this far on your own,
scripts.translation: 如果你以为能凭自己的本事走到这里，

scripts.text: you're mistaken.
[Ahat]
Everything is as the Master has planned.
scripts.translation: 一切都按主人的计划进行。

scripts.text: For now, let's see if you can open this door.
scripts.translation: 现在，就让我看看你们能不能打开这扇门。

scripts.text: Only party leaders can perform this event.
scripts.translation: 只有队长才能执行此活动。

scripts.text: If you want to activate the soul globes, you need Shnaim's soul.
scripts.translation: 若要激活灵魂球，需要施奈姆的灵魂。

scripts.text: Inject {0}'s soul into the empty soul globe.
scripts.translation: 将{0}的灵魂注入空的灵魂球。

scripts.text: Successfully activated {0}'s soul globe.
[Boy]
You insignificant creature.
How dare you lay a hand on a god-in-waiting?!
scripts.translation: 竟敢对未来的神明动手？！

scripts.text: [Boy]
First, let me applaud you for coming this far.
scripts.translation: 首先，恭喜你们能走到这里。

scripts.text: You've been a good pawn.
What are you talking about?
[Boy]
I've been waiting for this day.
To get out of that corner of the demon world and rule the entire universe.
scripts.translation: 摆脱魔界的一隅，统治整个宇宙。

scripts.text: [Boy]
To achieve that, I realized I must abandon my old body.
scripts.translation: 为了实现这个目标，我明白自己必须舍弃旧躯体。

scripts.text: So I died--well, I let you kill me.
scripts.translation: 所以我死了...不，是让你们杀了我。

scripts.text: [Boy]
Death is an inevitable step to take before rebirth.
scripts.translation: 死亡是重生前不可避免的一步。

scripts.text: So I'm reborn--again, you brought me back.
scripts.translation: 于是我重生了...说到底，是你们让我复活的。

scripts.text: [Boy]
All this has been arranged so that I could be reborn as God.
scripts.translation: 这一切都是为了让我重生为神而安排的。

scripts.text: [Morroc]
That's right, you foolish humans!
scripts.translation: 没错，你们这些愚蠢的人类！

scripts.text: I died once, so that I could circle around the world and embrace it in my arms.
scripts.translation: 我曾经死过一次，为的就是绕世界一周，将它拥入怀中。

scripts.text: I've been reborn to engulf this world.
scripts.translation: 我重生归来，就是为了吞噬这个世界。

scripts.text: [Morroc]
I'll create a new world and become its Creator.
scripts.translation: 我要创造一个新世界，成为它的造物主。

scripts.text: Let me ask you, the first creatures that have stepped into my newborn land.
scripts.translation: 让我问问你们这些踏入我新生之地的第一批生灵。

scripts.text: [Morroc]
How'd you like to follow me and watch the birth of a new world?
scripts.translation: 你们愿意跟随我，一同见证新世界的诞生吗？

scripts.text: [Loki]
You're helpless.
And disgusting.
[Nidhogg]
You're with a mercenary.
Could you dismiss your current mercenary and hire me instead?
scripts.translation: 能不能解雇现在的佣兵，改为雇用我？

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
I already assisted you once.
Please be careful!
[Nidhogg]
allow me to aid you in this battle.
scripts.translation: 让我在这场战斗中助你一臂之力。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
My duty as the guardian isn't over yet.
scripts.translation: 我作为守护者的职责还没有结束。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGuardian Nidhogg has joined your party.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff守护者尼德霍格加入了你的队伍。^000000

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
That was a tough battle.
scripts.translation: 刚才那场战斗真不容易。

scripts.text: This may not be good enough, but I hope it'll help your growth.
scripts.translation: 这点东西或许不算什么，希望能助你成长。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGuardian Nidhogg has rewarded you with a large amount of EXP for defeating Brinaranea.^000000

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
Can this dreadful place compete with the Frost of the Genesis?
scripts.translation: 这可怕的地方能和创世之霜相提并论吗？

scripts.text: I can't say.
He's created nothing on his own. How did he convince himself to think that he could be a creator?
scripts.translation: 他什么都没亲手创造过，怎么会相信自己能成为造物主？

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
That was a tough battle.
scripts.translation: 刚才那场战斗真不容易。

scripts.text: This may not be good enough, but I hope it'll help your growth.

scripts.text: [Morroc]
You're good.
Can you take on the wolf that swallowed the sun?
scripts.translation: 你能对付吞下太阳的巨狼吗？

scripts.text: [Morroc]
If you can't handle him, then you can't handle a god now, can you?
scripts.translation: 连它都对付不了的话，你又怎么可能对付得了神？

scripts.text: [Morroc]
I'll watch you. Mwa hah hah!
scripts.translation: 我会看着你的。哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
Skoll... Skoll and Haati...
Everything in here is a mere copy of that in the outside world.
scripts.translation: 这里的一切都只是外界事物的复制品。

scripts.text: He's not a creator.
[Nidhogg]
Good job, again.
This may not be good enough, but I hope it'll help your growth.
scripts.translation: 这点东西或许不算什么，希望能助你成长。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
I don't know what to say.
We stopped the god-in-waiting.
scripts.translation: 我们阻止了那个未来的神明。

scripts.text: We accomplished our goal.
But I'm still unnerved.
[Nidhogg]
This world is created in the mind of Morroc's.
scripts.translation: 这个世界是由梦罗克的意识创造出来的。

scripts.text: He'll live forever in this garden he couldn't finish.
scripts.translation: 他会永远困在这个未完成的庭园里。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
He probably doesn't know his body is destroyed forever.
scripts.translation: 他大概还不知道自己的身体已经彻底毁灭了。

scripts.text: He was far too ambitious, even for him.
scripts.translation: 就连他自己也野心过头了。

scripts.text: He wanted to create a new world and become its creator,
scripts.translation: 他想创造一个新世界，成为它的造物主，

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
but he couldn't create anything on his own.
scripts.translation: 却连一样东西都无法凭自己创造。

scripts.text: He abandoned his Demon body, just to become a mere facsimile of an existing god.
scripts.translation: 他舍弃了魔物的躯体，结果只是变成了现有神明的拙劣仿制品。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
He took the shape of a man.
He wasn't creative enough to reinvent the concept of God.
scripts.translation: 他没有足够的创造力去重新定义神明。

scripts.text: He was a paradox.
[Nidhogg]
Now we need to get out of this trap in time and end; to reality.
scripts.translation: 现在我们得及时逃离这个陷阱，回到现实世界。

scripts.text: This world only exists in the Demon God's mind. The same day repeats forever.
scripts.translation: 这个世界只存在于魔神的意识中，同一天会永远重复。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
Everyone who enters this world will be dragged into the same loop.
scripts.translation: 所有进入这个世界的人都会被拖进同一个循环。

scripts.text: In that sense, he succeeded in making his own world.
scripts.translation: 从这个角度来说，他确实创造了属于自己的世界。

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
Today's despair will repeat day after day.
scripts.translation: 今天的绝望会日复一日地重演。

scripts.text: Even though we know this, we'll come back to walk the same path again. I hope I'll be able to fight by you every time...
scripts.translation: 即使知道这一切，我们仍会回来，再走一次相同的路。希望每次都能与你并肩作战...

scripts.text: [Nidhogg]
I've talked too much. The Commander must be waiting. Let me validate your feat, so you can report to him.
scripts.translation: 我说得太多了。指挥官一定在等着。让我确认你的功绩，你就可以去向他报告了。

scripts.text: You did great today.
[Nidhogg]
...It feels like things are not over yet,
This is very close to Morroc's spiritual world,
scripts.translation: 这里非常接近梦罗克的精神世界，

scripts.text: He should be here to keep thinking about the past!
scripts.translation: 他应该就在这里，不断回想着过去！

scripts.text: Exit.
[Nidhogg]
Of course. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation: 当然可以。你一定累坏了。

scripts.text: Let me send you to the other members of your Expedition, free of charge.
scripts.translation: 我免费送你去和远征队的其他成员会合。
